Simulated monthly Kuroshio offshore-distance time series

Source: R/data_distance_sim.R
distance_sim.Rd

A simulated monthly time series representing the offshore distance of the Kuroshio current path. The dataset is provided as a univariate ts object and is intended for use as an example exogenous variable with sst_sim.

Usage

distance_sim

Format

A univariate ts object with:

frequency

12 (monthly data)

start

January 1998

end

February 2023

distance

Simulated offshore distance of the Kuroshio current path

Source

Simulated data generated for tempssm based on Baba et al. (2024). The original study's supplementary code and test data are available at: https://github.com/logics-of-blue/sea-temperature-trend-jogashima

Details

The original source information used in Baba et al. (2024) was based on the Japan Coast Guard's Ocean Current Forecasts and Reports, which provide offshore-distance information for the Kuroshio current axis. The original workflow used semi-monthly data with frequency = 24, including preprocessing steps such as averaging within half-month periods and linear interpolation for missing values. This simulated dataset is represented as monthly data with frequency = 12 for use with the package examples.

This dataset is not the original observed Kuroshio-distance record. It was generated by simulation based on the state-space model analysis of sea temperature time series off Jogashima reported by Baba et al. (2024). The name distance_sim is used to make the simulated nature of the dataset explicit. Missing values, if any, are encoded as NA.

References

Baba, S., Ishii, H., and Yoshiyama, T. (2024). Estimating sea temperature trends using a linear Gaussian state-space model in Jogashima, Kanagawa, Japan (in Japanese with an English abstract).

Baba, S. (2024). Supplementary code and test data for estimating sea temperature trends using a linear Gaussian state-space model. https://github.com/logics-of-blue/sea-temperature-trend-jogashima

Examples

data(distance_sim)
head(distance_sim)
#>      Jan Feb Mar Apr May Jun
#> 1998 116 148  49 131  45  40
